text:
Marta (Finance): Heads up — QuantumFlow invoice QF-3001 for $5,760 failed PO match. Vendor references PO 3001-2025 but Coupa linked 3001 to an internal test PO. Due in 4 days.
Amit (ProcureOps): Can you share the PDF + vendor tax id? Might be a namespace collision with our test PO prefix.
Marta (Finance): Uploading invoice now. Tax ID: 44-5566778. Vendor also attached a signed SOW.
invoicer-bot: Invoice QF-3001 uploaded by supplier (auto-match confidence: 0%). Note: PO number 3001 already in system (type: internal).
Renee (Vendor Manager): QuantumFlow AR called. They say the PO was issued by buyer @Kai and that it should be 3001-2025.
Kai (SRE): Confirmed I created PR-300 for a load test but never intended a PO. Looks like someone reused the short PO number when creating the production PO — my bad.
Amit (ProcureOps): Ok — plan: create a retro PO 3001-2025-retro, remap in Coupa to supplier id 8991, and add note preventing collision. Need legal/ops approvals.
Harper (Legal): CLM shows SOW signed by vendor but countersign missing. I can issue a limited commercial ACK for PO creation if vendor emails acceptance of Redwood standard T&Cs.
vendor-bot: Automated reminder sent to QuantumFlow AR requesting T&C acceptance.
Renee (Vendor Manager): They're willing to confirm via email. Sending now.
Marta (Finance): Bank last4 3344 confirmed by phone. Vendor is asking to waive the $45 late fee if paid within 48 hours.
Lina (Payments): We can do a 50% expedited payment once Finance marks matched and approvals present; remainder on final match. Treasury needs Ops approval and a legal ack.
Kai (SRE): I’ll approve the retro PO for my team since this was our request. Also adding a note to PR-300 to avoid future number reuse.
Amit (ProcureOps): Creating PO 3001-2025-retro in Coupa now. Note: "Retro PO to clear QF-3001; prevent numeric collision with test PO 3001." Routing: Kai -> Harper -> Marta.
invoicer-bot: PO 3001-2025-retro created (status: pending approvals).
Harper (Legal): Received vendor email accepting standard T&Cs. Providing commercial ACK now.
Marta (Finance): Legal ACK received. Kai approved PO. Amit — please fix supplier mapping in Coupa so future invoices map to supplier id 8991.
Amit (ProcureOps): Done — supplier mapping updated and locked for PO range 3001-3005.
Lina (Payments): Queuing 50% expedited sweep once Finance marks invoice matched. Send me the remittance contact.
Renee (Vendor Manager): Sent remittance details to @Lina via DM. Vendor confirmed they’ll waive late fee if we complete payment today.
Marta (Finance): Marking invoice matched now. Thanks all :thumbsup: 
Lina (Payments): Got it — queued 50% for expedited sweep. Remaining 50% release on final match/closure.
Kai (SRE): Logged retro action to prevent future PO collisions. Will follow up with ProcureOps to apply name prefix policy.
Marta (Finance): Closing loop — vendor notified and partial payment processing. Will monitor for final PO closure and release remainder.
